references.text: Detailed instructions about the peace offering (שְׁלָמִים) explaining the ritual Nahshon performs here.
The laws concerning the peace offering, including how the sacrificial animals were to be treated and divided.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, is mentioned as Aaron's father-in-law, highlighting his prominent position in the tribe of Judah.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, is identified as the leader of the tribe of Judah.
Nahshon leads the tribe of Judah in the camp and is the first to bring an offering at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Nahshon is mentioned in the genealogy of Judah, confirming his important position in Israel's history.
Instructions about offering cattle (בָּקָר) as a burnt offering and a peace offering.
Nahshon is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus, showing his significance in salvation history.
